title: Eval tallies read yes and no votes from file names
what: bin/eval-record reads the yes/no votes of a run from the names of files (bin/eval-record:23, :92, :102); store the votes of one run in one JSON file.
why: A file name that is renamed, truncated or copied changes a vote, and a tally built on it is a wrong answer about the judge.
failing_case: rename or copy a vote file of a run (for example give a vote file a name with an extra suffix): the tally counts it as another vote or none; votes in one JSON per run cannot be changed by a name
pass_cases: a run whose vote files carry the expected names tallies correctly today
